options.label: Update yt-dlp first
options.tooltip: Update yt-dlp to the latest release before running.

options.label: Ignore errors
options.tooltip: Continue with next video on download errors instead of aborting.

options.label: Keep going on errors
options.tooltip: Do not stop the entire playlist when one video fails.

options.label: Rate limit
options.tooltip: Maximum download rate, e.g. 50K or 4.2M.

options.label: Retries
options.tooltip: Number of retries for HTTP/HTTPS requests (default 10, or infinite when used with --fragment-retries).

options.label: Fragment retries
options.tooltip: Retries for fragment downloads (DASH/hls).

options.label: Parallel fragments
options.tooltip: Number of DASH/HLS fragments to download in parallel.

options.label: Skip missing fragments
options.tooltip: Skip unavailable fragments for DASH/HLS manifests.

options.label: No .part files
options.tooltip: Do not use .part files; write directly to the final filename.

options.label: Overwrite existing files
options.tooltip: Overwrite existing files and do not resume partial downloads (avoids HTTP 416 on stale files).

options.label: Extract audio
options.tooltip: Extract audio from the downloaded file.

options.label: Audio format
options.tooltip: Convert audio to this format (requires -x).

options.label: Audio quality
options.tooltip: Audio quality for conversion (0=best, 10=worst; or specific bitrate).

options.label: Post-processor arguments
options.tooltip: Extra arguments for post-processors (e.g. ffmpeg:-threads 8).

options.label: Format
options.tooltip: Video format selector (e.g. bestvideo+bestaudio, mp4).

options.label: Sort order
options.tooltip: Sort formats by fields (e.g. res:1080,codec:h264).

options.label: Container
options.tooltip: Container format used when merging video and audio.

options.label: Remux to
options.tooltip: Remux video to another container if necessary.

options.label: Output template
options.tooltip: Output filename template.

options.label: Download folder
options.tooltip: Base directory for downloads (paths home/temp etc.).

options.label: Paths
options.tooltip: Colon-separated list of additional paths for --download-archive etc.

options.label: Replace in metadata
options.tooltip: Replace text in metadata fields (FIELD:REGEX:REPLACE).

options.label: Download subtitles
options.tooltip: Write subtitle file if available.

options.label: Auto-generated subtitles
options.tooltip: Write automatically generated subtitles.

options.label: Subtitle languages
options.tooltip: Languages for subtitles, comma-separated (wildcards allowed).

options.label: Embed subtitles
options.tooltip: Embed subtitles in the video (mp4/webm only).

options.label: Username
options.tooltip: Account username for login (use with --password or netrc).

options.label: Password
options.tooltip: Account password. Stored in profile on disk — use with care.

options.label: Cookies file
options.tooltip: Netscape cookie file path for authenticated downloads.

options.label: Use .netrc
options.tooltip: Use .netrc for authentication.

options.label: Embed metadata
options.tooltip: Embed metadata (title, artist, etc.) in the output file.

options.label: Embed thumbnail
options.tooltip: Embed thumbnail in the output file.

options.label: Thumbnail format
options.tooltip: Convert thumbnails to the given format.

options.label: Per-tool post-processor arguments
options.tooltip: Additional post-processor arguments (e.g. Merger+ffmpeg:-c copy).

options.label: Proxy
options.tooltip: Proxy URL for HTTP/HTTPS requests (e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080).

options.label: Socket timeout
options.tooltip: Socket timeout in seconds.

options.label: Bypass geo-restriction
options.tooltip: Bypass geographic restriction via faking X-Forwarded-For IP.

options.label: Geo-bypass country
options.tooltip: Two-letter country code for geo bypass.

options.label: Match filter
options.tooltip: Generic video filter (e.g. duration > 60).

options.label: Stop at first filtered video
options.tooltip: Stop when a filter is not met instead of rejecting the video.

options.label: Download archive
options.tooltip: Archive file to skip already-downloaded videos.

options.label: Maximum downloads
options.tooltip: Stop after this many videos are downloaded.

options.label: Playlist items
options.tooltip: Playlist items to download (e.g. 1-5,7,10-15).

options.label: Quiet
options.tooltip: Quiet mode — only print errors.

options.label: Verbose
options.tooltip: Verbose mode — print debug output.

options.label: Simulate only
options.tooltip: Do not download — only simulate.

options.label: Skip download
options.tooltip: Do not download the video (metadata only).

options.label: Remove SponsorBlock segments
options.tooltip: SponsorBlock categories to remove (e.g. sponsor,intro).

options.label: Sleep between requests
options.tooltip: Seconds to sleep between requests during extraction.

options.label: Extractor arguments
options.tooltip: Extractor-specific arguments (KEY:ARGS). Prefer Extra Args for complex values.
